events.csv.description: Associated candidate events and GaMMA estimated attributes; coordinates are association coordinates, not a final absolute location.

assignments.csv.description: One row for every input pick, preserving its identity and whether GaMMA assigned it to an event.

run_result.json.description: Run status, effective configuration, counts and absolute output paths. Failed runs contain status and error.

note: Location refinement and catalog filtering are downstream workflow decisions. Event and pick indices are local to this run.
